directories.description: The redirect: index.html and 404.html, both sending any address under https://litlfred.github.io/vaxlink/ to https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/ with the old hash route mapped to the viewer's path route. Put at the root of gh-pages by scripts/publish-gh-pages.sh, which .github/workflows/deploy.yml runs on main.
publish-gh-pages.sh, which replaces the root of gh-pages with site/.
